newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: IPCL exchangeable Independent shares list in NZ.
newsitem.headline: IPCL exchangeable Independent shares list in NZ.

text.p: Independent Press Communications (IPCL) exchangeable Independent Newspapers Plc shares listed on the New Zealand stock exchange at NZ$8.30/share on Monday.
IPCL is a subsidiary and bidding vehicle of Independent Newspapers in its takeover bid for New Zealand publisher Wilson and Horton, which expires on Friday, November 15.
IPCL is offering NZ$11 for each Wilson and Horton share, or 1.375 exchangeable INP shares.
The exchangeable shares opened at $8.30 with 150,000 shares crossing at the open. Brokers said one broking house had bought the shares and there had not been any on-market trade.
The exchangeable shares have a face value of $8.00, pay a five percent dividend yield and can be converted to shares in Independent Plc in November, 2003.
Independent shares also listed but were untraded.
At the close of business on Friday, IPCL had secured 77 percent of Wilson and Horton shares, with 18.2 million of the total of 40 million exchangeable shares available taken up.
